name: Apps de EL ALE :)
subtitle: Aplicaciones utiles para leo
description: Aquí puedes instalar aplicaciones y emuladores como Gen1Recomp, iCube, Manic EMU, MeloCafe y PPSSPP.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.subtitle: Juega a juegos de PSP con controles y gráficos configurables.
apps.localizedDescription: Emulador de PlayStation Portable para iPad. Permite ajustar opciones gráficas y de rendimiento, personalizar los controles táctiles y utilizar mandos compatibles. No incluye juegos.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Your camera may be used to emulate Go!Cam, a camera accessory
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Your local network needs to be accessed by PPSSPP for network multiplayer support.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location may be used to emulate Go!Explore, a GPS accessory
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Your microphone may be used to emulate Go!Cam/Talkman, a microphone accessory
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Access to your photos is needed to allow setting a background image.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.localizedDescription: Spoti sin anuncios, con descargas y muchas cosas mas. Calidad premium.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This lets you unlock new ways of interacting with other devices compatible with Spotify via Bluetooth.

apps.name: Gen1Recomp
apps.subtitle: Recompilación nativa de Pokémon para iOS.
apps.localizedDescription: Gen1Recomp permite importar y jugar copias propias de juegos Pokémon compatibles. No incluye ROMs. Esta versión oficial utiliza HealthKit para la función Pokéwalker: iOS puede solicitar permiso para leer los pasos.

privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: The Pokéwalker mod reads your step count to give your Pokémon party experience points for real-world walking.

apps.name: iCube
apps.subtitle: Emulador de GameCube y Wii para iPhone y iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Emulador de Nintendo GameCube y Wii para iOS/iPadOS, basado en Dolphin. Incluye gestión de biblioteca, guardados, controles táctiles y compatibilidad con mandos. No incluye juegos. Esta entrada utiliza la compilación alpha 458 oficial; puede contener errores. La fuente declara Increased Memory Limit, Extended Virtual Addressing y get-task-allow como capacidades deseadas para la firma; deben estar autorizadas por el perfil de aprovisionamiento.

versions.localizedDescription: Compilación alpha 458 oficial de iCube, publicada el 5 de noviembre de 2026. Versión de prueba.

apps.name: MeloCafe
apps.subtitle: Emulador de Nintendo Wii U basado en Cemu.
apps.localizedDescription: MeloCafe es un emulador de Nintendo Wii U para iPhone y iPad basado en Cemu. No incluye juegos; importa únicamente copias propias. Para cargas grandes declara Increased Memory Limit y Extended Virtual Addressing. get-task-allow permite la conexión del depurador necesaria para el flujo de JIT con StikDebug. Estas capacidades dependen de la firma y del perfil de aprovisionamiento.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: MeloCafe uses the camera when Wii U software requests the GamePad camera.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MeloCafe uses the microphone when Wii U software requests GamePad microphone input.

apps.name: Manic EMU v2.0.2
apps.subtitle: Love Retro Games
apps.localizedDescription:
Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. Console, handheld, arcade, computer, and mobile classics live in one library. The app does not include games, BIOS, or game data. Use only legally owned backups, homebrew, or public-domain software.

Supported Platforms

Nintendo
- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
- Nintendo GameCube (NGC)
- Nintendo Wii (Wii)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Virtual Boy (VB)
- Pokemon Mini (PM)

Sony
- PlayStation (PS1)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)

Sega
- Dreamcast (DC)
- Sega Saturn (SS)
- Sega Master System (MS)
- Game Gear (GG)
- SG-1000 (SG)
- Sega Genesis 32X (32X)
- Sega CD / Mega-CD (MCD)
- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (MD)

NEC
- PC Engine (PCE)
- TurboGrafx-16 (TG-16)
- TurboGrafx-CD (TG-CD)
- SuperGrafx (SGX)

SNK
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGPC)

Atari
- Atari 2600
- Atari 5200
- Atari 7800
- Atari Jaguar
- Atari Lynx

Commodore
- Commodore 64 (C64)
- Amiga

Other
- Arcade
- DOOM
- MS-DOS
- Java ME (J2ME)
- Symbian

More systems are planned.

[RetroAchievements]
- Challenge players worldwide and light up trophies that are yours
- Multiset: grind multiple sets on one game — earn subset trophies without patching
- Hardcore Mode: tougher rules, trophies that actually count

[Save States, Your Way]
- Unlimited manual save states plus 50 auto slots
- Save Manager: browse by time, compare, and restore in one tap

[Speed, Cheats & Shortcuts]
- 5x fast forward — you set the pace
- Cheats on demand from an online library
- Custom shortcuts for save, speed, and screenshots

[Filters, Skins & Screenshots]
- Retro filters from our exclusive library
- Skins that feel like real hardware, third-party skins welcome, flex layouts that fit your hands
- Screenshots for the highlight reel

[Landscape Library]
- Landscape console mode — library, covers, and shortcuts on one screen
- Background music and navigation sounds — browsing feels like an arcade
- Browse with a controller or keyboard — stay on the couch

[Play Together]
- Local multiplayer whenever you want
- Eligible cores can host rooms, scan LAN, connect over relay, and spectate

[Cloud Import in One Step]
- Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, Aliyun
- WebDAV and SMB too — bring the whole library over in one go

[Controllers Your Way]
- Native Joy-Con, DualShock, and Xbox support
- Bluetooth controllers and keyboards — play on Mac too
- Multiple controllers at once, solo or a full party

[AirPlay — Living Room Ready]
- AirPlay to a TV or display
- Phone to TV without a hitch — couch nights and hangouts
- Big screen plus a controller — immersion maxed out

- Improved 3DS performance
- Nimbus in Artic Base now supports the latest Pretendo
